components.input: Examined for EmailWorker.process; discussed in relation to retry limits and dead-letter handling. 1| """Delivers transactional emails (order confirmations, password resets) from the email_jobs queue.""" 2| 3| import logging 4| import smtplib 5| from dataclasses import dataclass 6| from email.message import EmailMessage 7| 8| MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3 9| 10| log = logging.getLogger("email_worker") 11| 12| 13| @dataclass 14| class EmailJob: 15| id: str 16| to: str 17| subject: str 18| body: str 19| attempts: int = 0 20| 21| 22| def send_email(job: EmailJob, host: str = "localhost", port: int = 25) -> None: 23| message = EmailMessage() 24| message["To"] = job.to 25| message["From"] = "orders@tidepool.example" 26| message["Subject"] = job.subject 27| message.set_content(job.body) 28| with smtplib.SMTP(host, port, timeout=10) as smtp: 29| smtp.send_message(message) 30| 31| 32| class EmailWorker: 33| """Pulls jobs from a queue and sends them, retrying failed sends up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times.""" 34| 35| def __init__(self, queue): 36| self.queue = queue 37| 38| def process(self, job: EmailJob) -> None: 39| try: 40| send_email(job) 41| except (smtplib.SMTPException, OSError) as err: 42| job.attempts += 1 43| if job.attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS: 44| self.queue.put(job) 45| log.warning("send failed for %s: %s", job.id, err) 46| 47| def run_forever(self) -> None: 48| while True: 49| self.process(self.queue.get())
